title: Mitochondrial DNA and aging in fruit flies
body: Mitochondrial DNA mutations accumulate with age in Drosophila melanogaster, correlating with reduced lifespan and impaired electron-transport-chain function.

title: Coral bleaching thresholds
body: Repeated exposure to sea-surface temperatures above 29.5°C for more than 8 weeks induces irreversible bleaching in most scleractinian reef-building corals.

title: Perovskite solar cell stability
body: Hybrid organic-inorganic perovskite solar cells exhibit rapid performance decay under ambient humidity above 60%, with PCE dropping 20% within 72 hours.

title: Gut microbiome diversity in urban populations
body: Alpha-diversity of the human gut microbiome is inversely correlated with urbanization level, with rural cohorts showing 1.4× higher Shannon index on average.

title: Cosmic ray anisotropy at TeV energies
body: Large-scale anisotropy in cosmic ray arrival directions is observable at TeV energies with amplitudes near 10^-3, showing dipole alignment with the local interstellar medium.

title: CRISPR off-target effects in primary T cells
body: High-fidelity Cas9 variants reduce off-target cleavage rates in human primary T cells by over 90% compared to wild-type Cas9, with retained on-target efficiency.

title: Permafrost methane flux trends
body: Arctic permafrost zones show a statistically significant increase in methane flux over the 2010-2020 decade, driven primarily by thawed yedoma soils.

title: Graph neural networks for protein function
body: Graph neural networks trained on protein-protein interaction graphs outperform sequence-only models on function prediction by 7-12% in F1 on standard benchmarks.

title: Ocean acidification and pteropod shells
body: Pteropod shells in the Southern Ocean show measurable dissolution at aragonite saturation states below 1.2, a threshold already reached seasonally in some regions.

title: Quantum error correction surface codes
body: Surface code implementations on superconducting qubits achieve logical error rates below the physical error threshold when code distance exceeds 5 under realistic noise models.

title: Wildfire smoke and cardiovascular hospitalization
body: Short-term exposure to PM2.5 from wildfire smoke is associated with a 1.9% increase in cardiovascular hospitalization per 10 μg/m³ increment in U.S. cohorts.

title: Lithium-ion cathode degradation mechanisms
body: NMC-811 cathodes suffer accelerated capacity fade via particle cracking at charge rates above 2C, correlated with anisotropic lattice contraction.

title: Tropical rainforest carbon sink decline
body: The Amazon rainforest carbon sink has declined by approximately 30% since the 1990s due to combined effects of deforestation, drought, and rising temperatures.

title: Deep learning for medical image segmentation
body: U-Net variants with attention gating achieve state-of-the-art Dice scores above 0.92 on the BraTS brain tumor segmentation benchmark.

title: Antibiotic resistance gene dissemination in rivers
body: Wastewater treatment plant effluent is a major vector for antibiotic resistance gene dissemination in downstream river sediments across European watersheds.
